name: Bravos
description: Thugs, duelists, and mercenaries selling muscle and violence.

typeUpgrades.name: Bravos Rigging
typeUpgrades.description: You get 2 free load in two of the equipment categories (weapons, implements, supplies, gear, documents, and tools).

typeUpgrades.name: Ironhook Contacts
typeUpgrades.description: Your Tier is effectively +1 higher in prison.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Rovers
typeUpgrades.description: Your Rovers cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Thugs
typeUpgrades.description: Your Thugs cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Hardened
typeUpgrades.description: Each PC gets +1 trauma box. Costs three upgrades to unlock, not just one.

features.name: Dangerous
features.description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Hunt, Skirmish, or Wreck (up to a max rating of 3).

features.name: Blood Brothers
features.description: Your cohorts get +1d for teamwork rolls when fighting alongside you. All of your cohorts get the Thugs type for free (or an extra type, if already Thugs).

features.name: Door Kickers
features.description: When you use an assault plan, take +1d to the engagement roll.

features.name: Fiends
features.description: Fear is as good as respect. You may count each wanted level as if it were turf.

features.name: Forged in the Fire
features.description: Each PC has been toughened by cruel experience. You get +1d to resistance rolls.

features.name: Patron
features.description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

features.name: War Dogs
features.description: When you're at war (-3 faction status), your crew does not suffer -1 hold and PCs still get two downtime activities, instead of just one.

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
